senses.gloss: to rest, cease; esp. to observe the Sabbath, Lam. R. to V, 14 (expl. מנגינתם, ib.) מזמריהון שָׁבְתוּ they ceased from their songs.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:7">Ib. to I, 7</cite> (ref. to <he>משבתיה</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:7">ib.</cite>) <he>זה … שש׳ מתוכה</he> this refers to R. J. b. Z. who ceased from staying within her (who left Jerusalem during the siege).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 58b:19">Snh. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>נכרי שש׳ וכ׳</he> a gentile that rests from work (on any day) deserves death.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:31">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כבר ש׳ וכ׳</he> R. Ḥ. has already begun the Sabbath observance in his town.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 15:3:2">Y. Sabb. XV, 15ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>שבת לה׳ שְׁבוֹת כה׳ מה הקב״ה ש׳ ממאמר אף את שבות ממאמר</he> ‘a Sabbath unto the Lord’ (<cite ref="Exodus 20:10">Ex. XX, 10</cite>), rest like the Lord, as God rested from speech, so do thou rest from speech (planning work).

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 3:10">Ned. III, 10</cite> <he>הנודר משׁוֹבְתֵי שבת וכ׳</he> he who forswears benefit at the hands of those who rest on the Sabbath, is forbidden to receive benefits from Jews and from Samaritans; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 54a:17">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אור שש׳</he> a light which burned during the entire Sabbath (having been kindled on the Sabbath eve).

<cite ref="Menachot 21a:16">Men. 21ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>תשבית</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 2:13">Lev. II, 13</cite>) <he>מלח שאינה שׁוֹבֶתֶת וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שובתה</he>) a kind of salt which has no Sabbath (is generated at all times), which is Sodom salt (v. <cite ref="M01523"><he>מֶלַח</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to stay over the Sabbath; (of scholars) to deliver the Sabbath lecture.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 8:7">Peah VIII, 7</cite> <he>ש׳ נותנין לו מזון וכ׳</he> where the transient poor makes his Sabbath station, you must give him food for three meals; <cite ref="Shabbat 118a:5">Sabb. 118ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 9a:10">B. Bath. 9ᵃ</cite>. Mekh. Bo, s. 16 <he>כבר שָׂבְתוּ … ולא ש׳ וכ׳</he> once the disciples made their Sabbath station at Jabneh, but R. J. did not stay there. Ib. <he>ומי ש׳ שם</he> and who lectured there?; <he>אפשר שש׳ ר׳ וכ׳</he> is it possible that R. El. b. Az. lectured without sayîng something novel?; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:1:3">Y. Ḥag. I, beg. 75ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4:6">Y. Sot. III, 18ᵈ</cite> bot.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (v. שְׁבִיתָה) to appoint a Sabbath camp as the center for Sabbath movements.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:7">Pes. III, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 49a:3-4">49ᵃ</cite>) <he>ההולך … לִשְׁבּוֹת שביתת הרשות</he> if a person goes away from home … in order to transfer his Sabbath camp for some secular (social) purpose.

Erub. 51ᵃ לשׁוֹבְתֵי שבת for those who appoint a Sabbath camp (when on the road near the beginning of the Sabbath), v. פֵּאָה; a. fr.—Part. pass. שָׁבוּת allowed to rest, abandoned. Sifra B’har, Par. 1, ch. I (ref. to שבת הארץ, Lev. XXV, 6) מן הש׳ בארץ … מן השמור thou mayest (in the Sabbatical year) eat of what is abandoned in the earth (that which grows without special cultivation, manuring &c.), but not of what is watched in the earth (of a field more than ordinarily ploughed); Yalk. Lev. 659.

senses.gloss: to cause to cease, remove. Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ bot. שתשבור ותַשְׁבִּית עולו וכ׳ that thou mayest break and remove the yoke of the evil inclination &c.; ib. שתַּשְׁבִּיתֵהוּ מעלינו וכ׳ that thou mayest remove it (the leaven of evil) from within us &c.—V. הַשְׁבָּתָה.
